Purpose: 테넌트를 생성·활성화하고 로그인 사용자의 활성 테넌트 소속을 확인한다.
MainFeatures: 테넌트 생성; 테넌트 활성화; 내 테넌트 소속 조회
SearchConditions: 실제 API: mine에는 query 없음; 전체 목록·코드·명·상태·기간 검색 API 없음
InputItems: CreateTenantRequest(Code:string; Name:string); 활성화 tenantId:Guid; 요청 subject는 JWT sub
UserPermissions: PlatformAdministrator: 생성·활성화; TenantMember: 본인 소속 조회; route/membership filter 적용
ImplementationGaps: G-PLT-TNT-001-LIST: mine에는 query가 없고 directory는 PlatformAdministrator 전용 search·status·page·pageSize를 제공; ID/date filter 없음
DesignNotes: 기존 화면의 전체 목록 요구와 실제 mine API를 구분한다.

SearchConditions: search·status·page·pageSize server query; id/date filter 없음
ImplementationGaps: G-PLT-ORG-001-READ: ID/date filter 및 별도 status action 없음; update의 Name·Status 계약은 연결됨
DesignNotes: OrgManager는 현재 인증 정책으로 확인되지 않았다.

SearchConditions: search·status·page·pageSize server query; id/date filter 없음
ImplementationGaps: G-PLT-PJT-001-READ: ID/date filter 및 별도 status action 없음; update의 Name·Status 계약은 연결됨
DesignNotes: 조직이 선택된 테넌트 소속이며 active인지 service가 확인한다.

SearchConditions: search·status·page·pageSize server query; ID/date filter 및 초대 lifecycle query 없음
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; 선택 tenant membership; tenant 내 email uniqueness
ImplementationGaps: G-PLT-USR-001-LIFECYCLE: 초대 전용 lifecycle·status action 및 ID/date filter 없음; 사용자 update는 별도 PUT 계약
DesignNotes: 초대 상태를 화면에 표시할 Response DTO는 확인되지 않았다.

Purpose: 테넌트·조직·프로젝트 범위의 멤버십을 부여하고 목록·역할·회수·본인 소속을 관리한다.
MainFeatures: Tenant·조직·프로젝트 membership 부여; query-enabled 목록; Tenant 역할 변경·회수; 내 membership 조회
SearchConditions: 목록 query: subjectId·status·page·pageSize; mine은 활성 소속 배열이며 query 없음
OutputItems: grant {Id}; query page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items}; update 204; mine {TenantId:Guid; Role:string}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; 대상 subject active tenant membership 및 parent scope 검증; tenant route/membership 경계
ImplementationGaps: own-membership은 기존 활성 배열 계약을 보존; UI smoke·새 route testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: PATCH는 Role 또는 Revoke 중 하나를 받아 domain ChangeRole/Revoke를 호출한다.

MainFeatures: 정책 생성; 정책 목록·필터·페이징; 정책 평가; 정책 수정; 정책 활성화 변경
InputItems: CreateAuthorizationPolicyRequest(OrganizationId?:Guid; ProjectId?:Guid; SubjectId:string; Action:string; ResourceType:string; Effect:string; Priority:int); EvaluateAuthorizationPolicyRequest(OrganizationId?:Guid; ProjectId?:Guid; SubjectId?:string; Action:string; ResourceType:string); 수정 Effect·Priority; enabled IsEnabled:bool
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; OrganizationId; ProjectId; SubjectId; Action; ResourceType; Effect; Priority; IsEnabled; CreatedAtUtc]}; evaluate {IsAllowed; ReasonCode; MatchedPolicyId}; 수정/enabled 204
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; tenant/org/project scope 검증; 변경·평가 audit
ImplementationGaps: UI smoke·새 evaluation/filter route testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: Evaluation endpoint delegates to PlatformAuthorizationService; response omits policy body.

Purpose: 권한 감사 기록을 조회하고 무결성·아카이브·보존·작업 목록을 운영한다.
MainFeatures: 감사 조회; 무결성 계산·검증; archive 생성·검증; archive job 목록·상세·재시도·검증; archive schedule; retention
InputItems: Authorization audit query parameters; VerifyAuthorizationAuditIntegrityRequest(FromUtc; ToUtc; ExpectedSha256); archive/retention/job request DTOs
OutputItems: Page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; SubjectId; Action; ResourceType; Scope; IsAllowed; ReasonCode; MatchedPolicyId; OccurredAtUtc]}; archive job page fields are recorded in mapping.csv
ApiEvidence: GET /api/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/authorization-audit; GET /POST .../integrity; POST .../archives; GET .../archive-jobs; archive-jobs/{jobId}; retention; archive-schedule
ImplementationGaps: raw archive export는 없음; 새 archive-job list testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: Archive job collection is tenant scoped and page bounded.

Purpose: Tenant·조직·프로젝트·DataSet 저장소 할당량 정책을 필터·수정·이력과 함께 관리한다.
MainFeatures: 정책 목록; scope/enabled filter; 정책 생성; 정책 수정; 정책 활성화 변경; history
InputItems: CreateStorageQuotaPolicyRequest(Scope; TargetId; nullable limits; WarningThresholdPercent; PlanCode); Update ExpectedVersion; Enabled IsEnabled·ExpectedVersion
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[policy fields]}; history {before/after JSON and version fields}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; tenant/org/project/dataSet scope 검증; optimistic concurrency
ImplementationGaps: target/plan query 및 UI smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: scope/isEnabled query is server-side; no invented target/plan filter.

Purpose: Tenant 범위 DataSet을 목록·필터·상세로 확인하고 생성·활성화한다.
MainFeatures: DataSet 목록; 조직·프로젝트·이름·상태 filter; DataSet 생성; 상세; activate
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[DataSetSummary]}; detail {DataSet fields; SchemaRevisions}; 생성 {Id}; activate 204
ImplementationGaps: rename/delete/archive/restore API는 없음; 새 collection smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Collection list is implemented; lifecycle gap is recorded rather than inferred.

Purpose: DataSet의 불변 schema revision을 등록하고 page로 조회한다.
MainFeatures: schema 등록; current version; revision page 조회
SearchConditions: 전용 revision route는 page/pageSize page contract를 반환하며 version/date filter는 없음
OutputItems: 등록 {DataSetId; SchemaVersion}; page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Version; SchemaJson; CreatedAtUtc]}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator for write; TenantMember·route·membership for read
ImplementationGaps: diff/rollback 및 version/date query는 없음; 새 route smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Revision detail remains available through dataset detail.

Purpose: 콘텐츠 I/O와 Tenant/DataSet 사용량·이력·quota 이벤트를 확인한다.
MainFeatures: upload/download; DataSet·Tenant usage; history; quota event history
InputItems: upload는 request body stream; download은 octet-stream; filter query values are DateTimeOffset/string/int
OutputItems: usage DTO와 history/event DTO의 실제 필드는 mapping.csv에 기록
UserPermissions: TenantMember; content write/quota event는 TenantAdministrator; tenant boundary
ImplementationGaps: storage lifecycle·aggregate usage list filter는 없음; 새 filter smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: History and quota-event filters are source-backed; no local-only filtering.

MainFeatures: profile 생성·revision; profile 목록; execution 생성·목록·상세; details page; execution 삭제
SearchConditions: profiles: search·page·pageSize; executions: dataSetId·profileId·status·page·pageSize; details: skip·take
OutputItems: profile page; execution page; execution snapshot; detail page fields are recorded in mapping.csv
UserPermissions: TenantMember for read/result; TenantAdministrator for profile/revision/create/delete; idempotency
ApiEvidence: GET /datasets/validation-profiles; POST .../validation-profiles; POST .../{profileId}/revisions; GET /datasets/validations; POST .../{dataSetId}/validations; GET|DELETE .../{executionId}; details
ImplementationGaps: profile update/delete·date/failure filter는 없음; 새 list smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Execution scheduling continues to enqueue the Worker task with compensation.

Purpose: Tenant Worker task를 필터·페이징·상세로 확인하고 등록한다.
MainFeatures: task 목록; taskType/status/time filter; 상세; enqueue
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerTaskStatus]}; detail status includes progress/fencing/checkpoint/HasResult
ImplementationGaps: cancel·retry·result download API 없음; 새 list smoke는 NotRun

Purpose: 실패한 Worker 작업을 필터·페이징하고 replay 및 replay history를 확인한다.
MainFeatures: DLQ 목록; type/error/date filter; replay; replay history
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerDeadLetter]}; replay history {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerReplayHistory]}
ImplementationGaps: taskId/status는 item/detail field; UI smoke·new list route testhost는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Original task remains unchanged on replay.

Purpose: 외부 전달을 목록·필터·상세로 확인하고 관리자 수동 재시도를 요청한다.
MainFeatures: delivery 생성; 목록; status/host/error/date filter; 상세; manual retry
InputItems: CreateExternalDeliveryRequest(TargetUri; Payload; MaxAttempts) + Idempotency-Key; retry Idempotency-Key
OutputItems: page/detail safe projection; retry returns Delivery snapshot and WorkerTaskId
UserPermissions: TenantMember for read/create boundary; TenantAdministrator for create/retry; target allow-list; idempotency
ImplementationGaps: payload is omitted; UI smoke·new list/retry route testhost는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Manual retry resets a non-succeeded delivery and enqueues a new external-delivery task.
